questions.question: In which year did Niels Bohr propose a theory for the hydrogen atom based on the quantum theory that some physical quantities take only discrete values?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1913**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Niels Bohr:-**

 
 
• **He was a Danish physicist who made significant contributions to the development of atomic structure and quantum mechanics.**
 
• His theory for the hydrogen atom based on quantum theory is known as the Bohr model, which proposed that electrons orbit the nucleus in specific energy levels.
 
• **In 1913 Niels Bohr proposed his theory for the hydrogen atom based on the quantum theory that some physical quantities take only discrete values.**
 
• Niels Bohr's theory proposed that electrons in an atom can only exist in certain energy levels, and when they move between levels, they emit or absorb energy in the form of photons.
 
• This theory helped to explain the spectral lines of hydrogen and paved the way for further development of quantum mechanics.

questions.question: Which f-block element in the periodic table is represented by the Greek symbol 'alpha' and the metallic 'rays'?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Actinium**__.

__
 
• **Actinium:-**

 
 
• **The f-block element represented by the Greek symbol 'alpha' and the metallic 'rays' is Actinium, which has the atomic number 89 and belongs to the group 3 of the periodic table.**
 
• Actinium is a radioactive element that was discovered in 1899 by Andrundefined-Louis Debierne and named after the Greek word 'aktinos', meaning ray or beam, due to its high radioactivity.
 
• Actinium is a silvery-white metal that tarnishes in air and reacts with water and acids. It has no stable isotopes and its most stable isotope, Actinium-227, has a half-life of 21.8 years.
 
• Actinium is used in nuclear medicine for cancer treatment and as a neutron source in scientific research. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lanthanum:-**

 
 
• It is a soft, silvery-white metal that belongs to the lanthanide series and is used in the production of high-refractive-index glass, as well as in catalysts, electrodes, and other applications.
 
 
 
• **Rhenium:-**
 
 
• It is a dense, silvery-white metal that belongs to the group 7 of the periodic table and is used in high-temperature alloys, thermocouples, and catalysts.
 
 
 
• **Tungsten:-**
 
 
• It is a hard, dense, gray metal that belongs to the group 6 of the periodic table and is used in filaments, electrical contacts, and other applications.

questions.question: Which of the following is the compelling factor that produced a very high repayment rate of 98% in the concept of lending to groups of poor women, initiated by Dr Yunus?

options.text: Removal of the defaulter from the group
Joint liability putting social pressure to repay loans
Use of the services of aggressive loan recovery agents

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Joint liability putting social pressure to repay loans.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Joint liability:-**

 
 
• It means that all members of a group are responsible for each other's loans.
 
• Therefore, if one member defaults on a loan, the other members are responsible for repaying it. This puts social pressure on the group to repay loans on time.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In the concept of lending to groups of poor women, initiated by Dr Yunus, joint liability was used as a compelling factor to ensure a high repayment rate.
 
• The removal of a defaulter from the group may seem like a viable solution, but it does not address the root cause of defaulting on loans. Moreover, it may lead to social ostracization of the defaulter, which is not desirable.
 
• Involvement of 'loan sharks' and the use of the services of aggressive loan recovery agents (option 4) are illegal and unethical means of recovering loans. They do not address the root cause of defaulting on loans and may lead to further indebtedness of borrowers.

questions.question: Proportional taxes would help to reduce the autonomous expenditure multiplier because ______.

options.text: MPC does not have any role in it

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**taxes reduce the MPC.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Proportional taxes:-**

 
 
• A proportional tax is one where everyone pays the same percentage of their income in taxes. This means that as income increases, so does the amount of tax paid.
 
• It would help to reduce the autonomous expenditure multiplier because taxes reduce the MPC.
 
• The MPC, or marginal propensity to consume, is the fraction of additional income that a person or household spends. When taxes increase, disposable income decreases, which in turn reduces the MPC.
 
• By reducing the MPC, proportional taxes can help to stabilize the economy by dampening the effects of fluctuations in autonomous expenditure, such as changes in investment or government spending.
 
• Other types of taxes, such as regressive taxes (where lower-income people pay a higher percentage of their income in taxes) or progressive taxes (where higher-income people pay a higher percentage of their income in taxes), could have different effects on the MPC and the autonomous expenditure multiplier.
